classes.name: Bacterial Blight
classes.recommendation: Cassava Bacterial Blight (CBB) detected. Prune infected branches, apply copper-based bactericides (e.g. Copper Oxychloride), use certified disease-free stem cuttings, and destroy infected residues.

classes.name: Brown Spot
classes.recommendation: Cassava Brown Leaf Spot (Passalora henningsii) detected. Ensure proper plant spacing to facilitate air movement; apply preventative protectant fungicides like Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil if canopy defoliation begins.

classes.name: Green Mite
classes.recommendation: Cassava Green Mite (Mononychellus tanajoa) pest infestation detected. Introduce classical biological control predatory phytoseiid mites (Typhlodromalus aripo); avoid indiscriminate broad-spectrum organophosphate sprays.

classes.name: Healthy
classes.recommendation: Cassava foliage demonstrates vigorous chlorophyll pigmentation, intact leaf lobes, and no signs of bacterial exudates, fungal spotting, chlorotic mosaic mottling, or green mite stippling.

classes.name: Mosaic
classes.recommendation: Cassava Mosaic Disease (CMD) detected, transmitted by whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci). Immediately rogue severely stunted or distorted plants; plant CMD-resistant varieties; manage whitefly vector populations.
